notes.title: V1.3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]A major content update for SGRAW is here! One arena has been completely reworked, and two new arenas are available to fight in.[/p][previewyoutube="uACwqzp6olE;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]NEW ARENAS:[/h1][h2]THE WASTELAND (Redux)[/h2][p]The wasteland arena has been rebuilt from scratch. What started out as an effort to fix geometry issues turned into an overhaul of the layout. The original intent of a free-flowing map remains intact.  [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/2998f379b5801ec402b055a35c4e70b79517cdf5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/1effbebfa23e488f27e170dee469256ae6eb12b0.png"][/img][/carousel][h2]THE MOON[/h2][p]This place was originally built to be a mining rig to harvest ancient energies. Now? It's a battlefield.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/bbf7ee038778b6604ca181b459f21734f0829101.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/67dbf42b65f2e556fbe349eab1c4512efa865992.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/69ada93bb3268b13dffb2d00bc40e842a2365ee8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/b9216f8d132c6be47013f5ece02e65329ffe8a84.png"][/img][/carousel][h2]THE SPACESHIP[/h2][p]A former plaza for residents onboard, now turned into a combat arena after a recent collapse.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/247819daae53c5ef489148b2c9c592f51dcd318b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/9193c8fc76698642dd75ad45261091ffd9968175.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/fd17ddd8aef0a48148de7c2dd8f57c9b79341436.png"][/img][/carousel][h1]ACHIEVEMENTS:[/h1][p]Collect them all! Or don't - whatever works for you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/2ee4433c615db4bfa3b8192de749cbc497e62331.png"][/img][/p][h1]OTHER CHANGES:[/h1][list][*][p] Aim sensitivity should now be consistent regardless of framerate[/p][/*][*][p] Add "End Run" button to the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p] Fix some enemies not aiming at the player when firing[/p][/*][*][p] Add more images to ad billboards[/p][/*][*][p] Monkey-bars should be easier to grab now[/p][/*][*][p] Implement haptic feedback for DualSense controllers (Experimental, USB only)[/p][/*][*][p] The player should no longer spawn inside floors and walls when falling off the map or using the "Wrong Warp" debuff[/p][/*][*][p] "Last enemy remaining" indicators are now visible through everything[/p][/*][*][p] Add "Animation Quality" setting to the options menu[/p][/*][*][p] More performance improvements (Shader compilation stutter is still an issue for now) [/p][/*][/list][h1]OTHER INFO:[/h1][p]First of all, thank you so much for giving SGRAW a go and helping shape it. It might not be up there with the big leagues in terms of indie shooters, but it's still gone farther than I ever thought it would.

That said, I've been working on this game for over a year and a half now. While it's grown quite big and can grow further, it's also become a huge pain to maintain.
I'll skip the semantics: the plan for now is to make [b]one more update[/b] to improve performance where possible, [b]then move on[/b] to new projects. Can't stay doing the same thing forever. 

[/p][h2]REMINDER:[/h2][p]As always, join the [url="https://discord.gg/8g7yMStZVY"]Discord Server[/url] to report any bugs you find, as well as to suggest ideas or just chat about the game,

[/p][h3]See you in the arena.[/h3][p]~ Gurj[/p]

notes.title: V1.2 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
A major content update for SGRAW is here! Three new weapons added to your arsenal, with new enemies to use them on and more shop items to buy with your hard-earned tokens.

[previewyoutube=6th6qkr5HsI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]NEW WEAPONS:[/h1]
[h2]BURST[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/b4a9788409f9a3635e8566fea9dddad9f48d83dd.png[/img]
[i][b]Fires in three-round bursts. Kinda looks like a kitten.[/b][/i]
Well-rounded rifle. Missed shots stick to the ground, and can be picked back up.

[h2]COOLER[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/294918935f0bbbcb72a8bb94f7c366918ffa26a4.png[/img]
[i][b]💀❄ AWESOME SKULL THAT BREATHES FROST LIKE A FLAMETHROWER ❄💀[/b][/i]
Close-range annihilator. Chews through ammo, but deals massive damage up-close.

[h2]CONDUCTOR[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/a36134e684192cca74ae4c3d721d6ac515b5e737.png[/img]
[i][b]Full-auto hitscan eviscerator. Shoots bolts of electricity, like most guns do.[/b][/i]
Far-range point-and-shoot. Deals more damage the farther away you are from your target.

[h1]NEW ENEMIES:[/h1]
[h2]The SHOTGUNNER[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/f17f5e8bcf81d822eedca62f9b0381a3fe603c2f.png[/img]
You'll never guess what he does.

[h2]The INSECT[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/54f3bc342707ba1bca3af80db271c633c1d631af.png[/img]
Strolls around the arena, barraging you with slow-moving projectiles.
Can easily fill the air with bullets if ignored, making in-air navigation harder.

[h2]The MORTAR[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/21392d2742aa914438e75fca52deb698e56e967d.png[/img]
Launches explosive grenades. Keep an ear out for warning flares.

[h2]The JAWBREAKER[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/cd81ed9afd979fd321a087b397d98f7f3dfce56b.png[/img]
Uses its energy blades to slash through the air, creating waves of energy that turn the ground into a maze.
Weave through projectiles to hit its weak point, but be careful of its back-mounted turret.

[h1]NEW MODIFIERS:[/h1]
[b][REDACTED][/b]

[h1]OTHER CHANGES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Control rebinding is now available in the options menu
[*] The shop now lets you reroll items, once per run
[*] Completely rework "Cyber Hook" buff - it now controls more like an actual grapple hook
[*] The player now properly walks down slopes
[*] Launcher grenades should no longer clip through floors
[*] Fix CRT filter not scaling with window size
[*] Improve aiming on controller
[*] Add "Viewmodel FOV" slider to settings menu
[*] Add "Gamepad Vibration Intensity" slider to settings menu
[*] Movement should feel a bit less floaty while in mid-air now
[*] Optimize hit detection for player's bullets; no more finicky shield collisions
[*] Rearrange the entire in-game HUD
[*] Only rumble controller if it's the most recent input type
[*] Show descriptions for each weapon while in the hub area
[*] Improve performance even more
[/list]

[h2]REMINDER:[/h2]
As always, join the [url=https://discord.gg/8g7yMStZVY]Discord Server[/url] to report any bugs you find, as well as to suggest ideas or just chat about the game,
Updates for SGRAW will soon slow down, so get your suggestions in while you can!

[h3]See you in the arena.[/h3]
~ Gurj

notes.title: v1.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
A major content update for SGRAW has arrived! A new arena, new enemies, and new modifiers are here to spice up combat.

[previewyoutube=HQhFcfoT_Kw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]NEW ARENA:[/h1]
[h2]THE SEWERS[/h2]
After a long period in disuse, the local sewers have been refurbished and repurposed as a combat arena.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/e247de58c1754ba93870b64107b4381a78d83537.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/615b34b8fc27cc019e20b1016e89b13caf0b70de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/b1a9d62f74259a988c87dbe87884b1ef3e408d8b.jpg[/img]
The focus of this map is to encourage combatants to use all of their movement tech. Wall-running alone isn't gonna cut it here.

[h1]NEW ENEMIES:[/h1]

[h2]The TURRET[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/d5b26a4fffb8a7c4e4a338f25f2a683907e21c47.jpg[/img]
[i][b]He looks friendly.[/b][/i]
Turrets remain in a single fixed location, constantly firing bullets to maintain pressure. However, they're slow to turn; when low on resources, it's not a bad idea to approach a turret from behind to farm ammo/health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/951f75e007dba0d9f23e9a3bbdd4a2d78f6ce0f5.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Hopefully he won't mind if I borrow some ammo.[/b][/i]

[h2]The SCYTHE[/h2] (Richard)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/6bb68bf7f56d44c7a1e14cc857cb5d181e401f2f.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Going for a jog. Exercise is important.[/b][/i]
Scythes tend to idly stroll throughout the arena. They'll wait until a combatant's back is turned before switching into attack mode, relentlessly pursuing their target for a devastating strike.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/142f978cb6a2d49be94b425140091ce7bd9609d6.gif[/img]
[i][b]Shouldn't have interrupted the jog.[/b][/i]

[h2]The CYCLONE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/a858357b86ddd4d154964895500ad1ee2dbf50a8.jpg[/img]
Cyclones are protected by their iconic blue shield. The shield can be bypassed through explosions, plasma, or the big gap in the front. However, doing so causes the Cyclone to attack, which can either be inconvenient or straight-up deadly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/7bf0741d06e4f51d669e471e26c118860c565732.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Lasers do, oddly enough, tend to hurt.[/b][/i]

[h1]NEW MODIFIERS:[/h1]
Plenty of new modifiers have been added to the shop. Are you a fan of movement? Because we've got plenty of movement in this update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/65393b7f17e059cb15fd5f4bc73a0aa44fd38d22.png[/img]
Enough modifiers have been added, in fact, that the shop's capacity has been upgraded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/1c0b346e2f15353004af5872d2cca962725a0653.jpg[/img]
[i][b]More items up for sale per run, but watch what you purchase - prices go up after every purchase.[/b][/i]

[h1]OTHER CHANGES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix controller rumbling when it's not in use
[*] Stronger enemies now drop more health than regular ones
[*] Always compile shaders on startup to mitigate framedrops
[*] Fix viewmodel not being affected by Render Scale setting
[*] Advertisement billboards now properly emit light
[*] Redo CRT filter effect to maintain screen legibility
[*] The camera now properly tilts when wallrunning
[*] Change the crosshair for the Crossbow to better indicate which fire mode it's in
[*] Fix framerate drops tied to constant audio file decoding
[*] Optimize hit detection - bullets should now hit enemies from farther away
[*] Enemies now return to their original spawn points when falling out of arenas
[*] Fix being able to spawn inside walls when falling out of arenas
[*] Enemy melee attacks are no longer deafeningly loud
[*] The shotgun's alt-fire now reloads even when the gun's not equipped
[*] Add shadow quality option to settings menu
[*] Fix waves not properly registering as being finished
[*] Add an option in the console to replay the tutorial
[*] Add a bunch of easter eggs
[*] Fix z-fighting on objects far away from the camera
[*] Tweak the wave randomizer to give the player more chances to refill resources
[*] Fix several bugs that are too insignificant to properly document
[/list]

[h2]REMINDER:[/h2]
Join the [url=https://discord.gg/8g7yMStZVY]Discord Server[/url] to report any bugs you find, as well as to suggest ideas or just chat about the game,

[h3]See you in the arena.[/h3]
~ Gurj

notes.title: Welcome to SGRAW
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to [b]Shoot Giant Robots and Wallrun[/b].[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/5d1f6f8836037f559507922d51e9ad87bfc3e980.png[/img]
[h3][i][b]The objective is in the title.[/b][/i][/h3]

SGRAW is a game I made over the course of 7 months. It's a fast-paced, movement-heavy, action-packed shooter where the goal is simply to last as long as possible.
If you're familiar with any movement shooter released in the past few years, you probably get the idea.

[h3][i]The story does not matter.
There is no campaign.
There is only violence.[/i][/h3]

[previewyoutube=rRmYAeUIFvY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]An Adrenaline Rush Right From The Start[/h2]

It's simple. You get in the elevator, enter the arena, and mow down hordes of robots. You have your trusty gunstaff at your side, and 5 weapon attachments to choose from at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/142d16d628025ad2ff99e69c25509a961d7bdd67.jpg[/img]
[b][i]5 weapons at launch, each with unique alt-fires.[/i][/b]

Oh yeah, and the staff just so happens to have a sawblade on the other end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/2dba267c434694c9a9da958314b85fa85550840d.jpg[/img]
[b][i]They won't mind being cut up. Probably.[/i][/b]

Shoot enemies to get health back. Saw them to recover ammo. Pick your weapon and your tactic to fit the situation. Keep pushing forward.

[h2]Make A Purchase Or Two[/h2]

Every few waves, you have the option of buying upgrades to help you out.
They last until the end of the run, so buy them often.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/4f679f2496fdc53a40c3ec8edeff78a1602e87e3.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Lots of stuff to choose from, and items are shuffled every run.[/i][/b]

However, there's a catch - if you wanna buy an upgrade, you gotta buy a few downgrades first.
Some purchases are inconsequential. Others change the game entirely in drastic, and often stupid, ways.

[h2]Earn Bragging Rights[/h2]

Wanna flex? There's friend-only leaderboards. Show off your high score to your pals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937801/5f086205e217d09ecc957862515a589df1c0f930.jpg[/img]
[b][i]I swear, I've gotten better scores offline.[/i][/b]

[h2]Get In Touch[/h2]
If you report a bug, talk about the game, or just say hi, I have a Discord server up and running:
[url=https://discord.gg/8g7yMStZVY]discord.gg/8g7yMStZVY[/url]

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/gurjyt.bsky.social]I also have a BlueSky account, I guess.[/url]

[h2]Enjoy![/h2]
This is the first game I've ever made. It took a lot of effort and a lot of struggle, so I hope you have fun!

[h1]See you in the arena.[/h1]
~Gurj
